en: Hmm... Not a single Shroomish anywhere. They're supposed to love these damp woods.
Oh! Hello there. Have you seen a Shroomish around here? I study them, you see.
Hold it right there, Devon man! I've been waiting all morning for you to wander off on your own.
Those papers you're carrying belong to Team Aqua now. Give them here!
Eek! You there, trainer! Please, you have to help me! I'm no good at battling!
A kid playing hero? Get in Team Aqua's way and you'll be sorry!
Tch! Beaten by a kid. Fine, there are other ways into Rustboro. Remember this face!
Oh, my heart is still racing... Thank you! Please, take this as my thanks.
That grunt said something about Rustboro. Team Aqua must be after something at Devon!
I must hurry back and warn everyone. Goodbye, and thank you again!
You've come all the way through the woods? Your Pokémon must be tired. Here, this might help!
A Pokémon that holds a Miracle Seed puts more power into its Grass moves. Isn't that something?
